sentences.text: You leave an eight hundred fix steering zero four five true at eight knots.
At ten hundred your DR is sixteen miles along that course, but a ten hundred fix lies two point four miles from the DR, in the direction one two zero true.
The set is one two zero true, the direction from DR to fix.
The drift is two point four miles divided by two hours, one point two knots.
To find what you actually made good, measure the line from the eight hundred fix to the ten hundred fix: that’s your track and speed over the ground.
